# MotionVfx Live 0.8.7

- Fixed missing effect blocks and properties inside Action / PlayEmitter. Nested attributes can now be selected, edited and reloaded.
- Reduced repeated text measurement and offscreen drawing work when scrolling parameters, dragging or resizing the editor.
- Reduced background history processing while the editor is hidden or showing another page. Action capture and the current-action display remain active.
- Faster inspection of large EFX attributes, with cached results invalidated when the document or edits change.
- Removed an unintended disk write while generating EFX bytes in memory.

Download **MotionVfxLive-0.8.7-Setup.exe**. Close the game before updating; this version updates shared Lua modules and the backend. Existing installation and MDF-XL compatibility support are retained.

Validation includes real EFX round trips and offline tests using actual Dear ImGui input. Offline timings are not a measurement or guarantee of in-game FPS.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

- 修复 Action / PlayEmitter 内的特效块与属性未显示的问题，支持选择、编辑及重新读取内嵌属性。
- 减少滚动参数、拖动和缩放编辑器时重复测量文字及处理屏幕外绘制内容的开销。
- 减少隐藏编辑器或查看其他页面时的历史记录整理；动作捕获与当前动作显示继续运行。
- 加快大型 EFX 属性的读取；切换文档或修改内容后，相关缓存会失效并重新读取。
- 去除在内存中生成 EFX 数据时意外产生的磁盘写入。

下载 **MotionVfxLive-0.8.7-Setup.exe**。更新前请关闭游戏；本版涉及共享 Lua 模块和后台更新。保留旧版安装升级及 MDF-XL 兼容支持。

验证包含真实 EFX 回读，以及使用真实 Dear ImGui 输入的离线测试。离线耗时不等同于游戏帧率，也不构成实机帧率保证。
